description:
Non-Material Amendment to planning permission reference 202512 granted 20/04/2021
 to allow for minor amendment to block C approved via Planning Permission 202512 to facilitate fire safety improvements with internal works including
removal of internal connectivity between the ground floor escape route and refuse stores; provision of ventilation to lobbies; redistribution of
refuse and cycle spaces; removal of flat entrances direct from cores; provision of smoke shafts and ventilation with Automatic Opening Vent
(AOV) windows added to all communal corridors; inclusion of additional doors and walls to form sterile lift lobbies to each floor; limited small
scale adjustment to layout of affected apartments, along with elevation changes including provision of 10no. additional AOV windows;
conversion of 8no. approved doors/ windows to AOV’s; 3no. additional ground floor doors; adjustments to the size of 2no. window widths;
alteration of 1no. ground floor door with the addition of a canopy and partial changed mortar detailing relative to lower floors (south and east
elevations).
